mappedContracts.statement: Implementation may begin only after the user explicitly approves the green planning PR using the approved plan hash.
acceptanceCriteria: The planning receipt emits a canonical plan hash.
The prompt defines the required approval phrase and Codex verifies it before implementation.
No code implementation, dependency migration, release, registry submission, or live mutation occurs before approval.
requiredEvidence: Approval-gate logic in the canonical contract

mappedContracts.statement: Use trusted publishing, reproducible artefacts, provenance, clean-room installation, version synchronization, release notes, rollback, and staged release channels.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-lived npm publishing tokens are removed after OIDC trusted publishing is verified.
The exact tested tarball is published.
Tags, package metadata, registry metadata, SBOMs, MCPB, OCI image, and GitHub Release use one version.

mappedContracts.statement: Bring the project through a staged release train to a defensible 1.0 and maintain a post-1.0 roadmap.
acceptanceCriteria: Release gates are defined for 0.3 safety, 0.4 architecture, 0.5 frontier toolchain/MCP v2, 0.6 content fidelity, 0.7 Creator OS, 0.8 assurance/observability, 0.9 release candidate, and 1.0 maturity.
1.0 requires all MUST contracts satisfied or explicitly approved exceptions with expiry.
The post-1.0 roadmap covers official API evolution, plugin SDK, hosted gateway, team/agency workflows, ecosystem integrations, deprecations, and maintenance.
